description: A little space for whatever you want to share.
title: Section name
titleHelp: Optional. Use this name to organize the section in the editor. The checkbox below controls whether it also appears as a README heading.
titlePlaceholder: For example, How I like to work
showTitleHelp: Uncheck to export only the content. The section name and title formatting stay saved in the editor.
intro: Choose a block below. Each small sample shows its layout before you add it; the new block starts empty.
pickerTextHelp: A paragraph for your own words.
pickerBulletHelp: A list with a point beside each item.
pickerNumberedHelp: A list with automatic numbers for its items.
pickerLinkHelp: A web link with an optional label.
pickerHeadingHelp: A smaller heading to introduce part of this section.
pickerDividerHelp: A horizontal line that separates your content.
pickerQuoteHelp: A short phrase set apart with a vertical line.
pickerImageHelp: An image or banner from a public HTTPS address, with an accessible description.
pickerHtmlHelp: Your own HTML, with supported formatting and optional examples.
empty: Your section is ready. Choose a type of content to get started.
subtitle: Subtitle
subtitleHelp: Introduce the content that follows. This is a smaller heading inside your section.
quoteHelp: Write a phrase you want to set apart. The quote style is added automatically.
dividerHelp: This line separates the blocks around it. Move it with the arrows to place it where you want.
imageUrlHelp: Paste a direct HTTPS image address that opens without signing in. Use an image already hosted publicly; this tool does not upload files.
imageAltHelp: Describe what the image shows. This text is required to export an image and helps people who cannot see it.
invalidImageUrl: Enter a direct public HTTPS image address without spaces, credentials or a sign-in page.
missingImageAlt: Add a description of this image before copying or downloading your README.
orderHelp: Move blocks with the arrows. The first block cannot move up and the last cannot move down.
removeHelp: Removing a block deletes that block and its content from this section.
textHelp: Write in your own words. Starting the first line with a dash and a space (- ) turns it into a bullet list.
textPlaceholder: What would you like people to know?
listHelp: Enter adds the next item. Enter on the last empty item continues as text. Pasting several lines creates several items.
unorderedHelp: Each item gets a bullet point (•), for example: • Share what I learn. Points are added automatically; just write the text.
orderedHelp: Each item gets a number, for example: 1. Explore an idea. Numbers (1., 2., 3.) are added automatically.
emptyList: Add an item to start this list.
linkTextHelp: Optional. Leave it blank to show the address.
urlHelp: Use a full http:// or https:// web address.
invalidUrl: Enter a full http:// or https:// address. Email links are available in the Contact section.
convertedToList: Converted to a bullet list. You can use Convert to text to undo the format.
convertedToText: Converted to text. Item text and markers have been kept.
continuedAsText: List finished. Continue writing in the new text block.

html.help: Use HTML inside this block. Your original is saved; the preview and README use supported HTML. Markdown syntax here stays literal.
html.invalid: Review the HTML problems below before exporting. Your original code has been kept.
html.documentLimit: The included HTML blocks exceed {limit, number} characters in total. Shorten some HTML code or hide a section to export. Your original code has been kept.
html.characterCount: {count, number} of {limit, number} characters per block
html.formats: Use paragraphs, headings, bold or italic text, lists, links, tables, details and summaries, block quotes, code and horizontal dividers. Text alignment can be left, centered or right.
html.linksAndImages: Web links need full HTTP or HTTPS addresses. Images need public HTTPS addresses and an accessible description in alt. Scripts, styles, forms, embedded pages and event handlers are removed.
html.limits: Each block supports up to {length, number} characters, {nodes, number} nodes and {depth, number} nesting levels. Included HTML blocks support up to {documentLength, number} characters in total. GitHub may display supported formatting differently.
html.examplesHelp: These local examples are starting points. They are added only when you choose Use this example, and you can edit them afterwards.
html.replaceConfirmation: Replace the code in this HTML block with the example? The current code in this block will be removed. Other blocks will be kept.
html.exampleApplied: HTML example added. You can edit its code now.
html.exportedHelp: This is the supported HTML used by the preview and README. Your original code above stays unchanged. Fix any listed problems before exporting.

notices.unsupported_elements: Unsupported elements were removed from the output. Their readable content is kept when possible.
notices.unsupported_attributes: Unsupported attributes were removed from the output.
notices.comments_removed: HTML comments were removed from the output.
notices.repaired_html: The HTML structure was repaired for the output. Check the exported HTML below.

errors.too_large: This HTML block is too long. Shorten it or divide it into smaller blocks.
errors.too_complex: This HTML has too many nodes or nesting levels. Simplify its structure.
errors.invalid_url: Check the links and image addresses. Use full HTTP/HTTPS links and public HTTPS image addresses.
errors.missing_image_alt: Add a meaningful alt description to every image.
errors.invalid_structure: Review the HTML structure, especially tables, lists and nested elements.
errors.empty_html: There is no supported content to export. Add text or supported HTML, or clear this block.

pickerCodeHelp: A code snippet, configuration or informal profile with an optional language.

code.languageHelp: Choose a language for local highlighting, or select Plain text. Choose Custom to enter another identifier. GitHub may highlight it differently.
code.plainLanguageHelp: There is no local highlighter for {language}. Your code stays as plain text in the editor, and its identifier remains in the README.
code.customLanguageHelp: Enter a short identifier of up to {limit} characters. Unknown identifiers stay as plain text in the editor.
code.invalidLanguage: Use a short language name such as python, ts or c#. Spaces, Markdown fences and long identifiers are not supported.
code.help: Paste only the snippet, without Markdown fences. Spaces and line breaks are kept. HTML here is shown as code, never rendered or run.
code.tooLong: This code block exceeds {limit, number} characters. Shorten it or divide it into smaller blocks. Your source has been kept.
code.documentLimit: The included code blocks exceed {limit, number} characters in total. Shorten some code or hide a section before exporting. Your source has been kept.
code.characterCount: {count, number} of {limit, number} characters per block
code.exampleHelp: An informal way to introduce yourself. It is added only when you choose Use this example, and you can change every word.
code.replaceConfirmation: Replace the source and language in this code block with the JSON example? The current code in this block will be removed. Other blocks will be kept.
code.exampleApplied: JSON example added. You can edit the code now.

format.help: Choose a heading size or alignment. Your text stays literal. Centered and right-aligned text use supported HTML; GitHub may display it differently.
format.tooLong: The formatted text exceeds the supported HTML limits. Shorten this text, choose left alignment or hide another formatted or HTML section before exporting. Your text has been kept.
